title: Velvety Rich Croatian Beef Skewers
description: A funky and velvety Croatian dish featuring red wine jelly, perfect for a show-off dinner party, high in protein and rich in flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to 135 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
While the skewers are cooking, melt the red wine jelly in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the skewers are cooked, brush the melted red wine jelly onto the beef cubes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
